episodes.title: Why Being a "Good Girl" Nearly Ruined Me (Cult Survivor & ADHD Story) | Sin Society Ep. 1
episodes.description:
I was told my whole life to stay quiet and be a "good girl"—growing up inside a cult, surviving abuse, and numbing the trauma in my twenties. Today, I’m burning the rulebook, owning my destiny, and inviting you into Sin Society.

Welcome to Episode 1 of the Sin Society Podcast. In this premiere episode, I’m pulling back the curtain on who I am, the dark chapters I had to survive to get here, and why thriving through rebellion is the ultimate form of healing.

If you’ve ever felt like the black sheep, struggled with undiagnosed or misunderstood neurodivergence, or had to rebuild your entire identity from scratch after trauma—you belong here. We are expanding our field of vision, questioning everything around us, and refusing to shrink anymore.

In this episode, we get into:

Growing up in a high-control cult environment and breaking free

Surviving SA and DV

Navigating addiction in my 20s as a survival mechanism

Living with ADHD and battling different forms of depression

Why shedding the "good girl" conditioning changed my life

What to expect from Sin Society moving forward

Subscribe for weekly unfiltered conversations on trauma recovery, radical self-ownership, neurodivergence, and calling out the things nobody wants to talk about.
